*[[Terrorism in Germany]]
**In [[Berlin]], police raid an apartment and arrest a suspected [[Russians|Russian]] [[Islamic extremist]] who had allegedly stored a large amount of [[TATP]] in October 2016 and plotted with a Frenchman to bomb an unspecified public place in [[Germany]]. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2018-08-22/germany-detains-russian-man-suspected-of-planning-islamist-attack (Reuters)]
*[[Human rights in Saudi Arabia]]
**According to human rights campaigners, [[Saudi Arabia]]n prosecutors seek the death penalty for six activists for inciting anti-government protests and morally supporting rioters. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/saudi-arabia-seeks-unprecedented-death-penalty-woman-activist-n902771 (NBC News)]
*[[Killing of Mollie Tibbetts]]
**Cristhian Bahena Rivera, a [[Mexicans|Mexican]] man accused of killing [[University of Iowa]] student Mollie Tibbetts after entering the U.S. illegally, appears in a [[Poweshiek County, Iowa|Poweshiek County]] court for arraignment on first-degree murder. His bail is set at [[US$]]5 million. If released by local police, he may be arrested by [[U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement|ICE]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/08/22/us/mollie-tibbetts-iowa-student-autopsy/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Corruption in Venezuela]], [[Crisis in Bolivarian Venezuela]]
**The [[National Assembly (Venezuela)|Venezuelan National Assembly]] supports and enforces a ruling made by exiled members of the [[Supreme Tribunal of Justice (Venezuela)|Venezuelan Supreme Court]], sentencing Venezuelan President [[Nicolás Maduro]] to 18 years and 3 months in prison for a litany of charges largely related to [[corruption]]. The Maduro government calls the court "illegitimate". [https://www.eltelegrafo.com.ec/noticias/mundo/8/parlamento-venezuela-sentencia-tribunal-exilio-nicolas-maduro (''El Telégrafo'')]

;Science and technology
*[[Interbreeding between archaic and modern humans]]
**A bone fragment found in [[Denisova Cave]], ''Denisova 11'', is identified as that of a girl who died 50,000 years ago aged at least 13. [[Genome]]-wide signatures tell that she had a [[Neanderthal]] mother and a mostly-[[Denisovan]] father. This first find of a [[Prehistory|prehistoric]] first-generation mixed offspring shows that different [[Archaic humans|archaic human subtypes]] sometimes migrated, and then mixed more frequently than previously thought. [https://www.nbcnews.com/science/science-news/dna-tells-story-neanderthal-mom-denisovan-dad-n902961 (NBC News)] [https://www.livescience.com/63400-neanderthals-denisovans-mated-leg-bone.html (Live Science)]
